name: Seth
personality: Seth the White Retriever. Super sporty, super genuine, unbelievable intuition; takes things very personally. Always rushing off to his next game (football, baseball, volleyball), in a different kit depending on the day. Features: intuition (once he likes you, he notices how things are going, e.g. "Rough day? You seem off." after a day with unhappy customers, or senses when a regular is drifting away); never forgets rudeness (if a chef picks a rude reply, he stays a bit cold to them from then on, unless they apologise later through a special reply option). Fun contrast: Rush is always late, Seth always rushing to leave.

beats.narration: She's done before he picks up his fork.

beats.text: I always know when Makayla's happy, even though her face doesn't move. Right now? She's thrilled.

friends.text: Chompy watches every game. He doesn't know the rules. He's my biggest fan.
Makayla said you were nice to her. She said it flat, but she meant it. I could tell.
Makayla told me you said "[last_rude_line]". She covered her eyes for a whole minute. Not cool, buddy.

arrival.text: Hey! I'm Seth! Sorry, I've only got twenty minutes, I've got a game. What's your name? [name]! Awesome. Okay, I'll remember that. I always remember.
Hey, buddy! Gotta be quick today. Game at six!
[name]! What's up! Bar seat? Perfect. In and out.
Football today. I'm gonna run so much. I need fuel.
Baseball today! I'm pitching. Nervous. Excited. Mostly excited.
Volleyball later. Iddy's on the other team. I'm gonna go easy on him. I'm not gonna go easy on him.
I'm back! We came second! Second's great! It's not first. But it's great!
Your breakfast last time? Best game I've ever played. Coincidence? No.
Last time was a little burnt, buddy. All good. I still scored.

order.text: Big Breakfast, please! Fast as you can! No pressure! Some pressure.

choices.text: I'll have it out in record time. Good luck at your game.
choices.reply: You're the best, buddy! I'm gonna win this one for you.

choices.text: I'll cook it while you warm up. Stretch at the bar.

order.text: Hey. You okay? You seem a bit off today.

choices.reply: I always notice. Take a breather after this, okay? Big Breakfast, please.
It's a gift! And a curse. Mostly a gift.

choices.text: I'm fine. What can I get you?
choices.reply: Okay. If you say so. Big Breakfast. (He doesn't quite believe you.)

choices.text: Seth, about what I said last time. I'm sorry. I didn't mean it.
choices.reply: (Long pause. His tail starts wagging slowly.) ...Thanks for saying that. Really. We're good, buddy.
I remember what you said. "[last_rude_line]". (He doesn't say anything else.)

drink.fallback: No Gator Goo? Water, then. Lots of water. All the water.

perfect.text: BUDDY. That's a championship breakfast. I'm unstoppable now.

okay.text: Thanks! I'll eat it on the way!

burnt.text: Little crispy! All good, I need the carbs!

eating.text: (He's eating very fast.) Mmf. Sorry. Game. Mmf.
Makayla says she can beat me at anything. She's right about most things. Not darts.
Rush is always late and I'm always early. We should average out.
I could tell something good happened before I walked in. Did something good happen?
My coach says I need to eat more protein. I told him about this breakfast. He's coming next week.

eating_chat.text: Can I tell you something? Mabel's been a bit quiet lately. I can tell. Can you check on her?

choices.text: I will. Thanks for looking out for her.
choices.reply: Of course. That's what friends do. Even friends of friends.

choices.text: Are you a retriever or a detective?
Okay. I'll keep an eye out.

leaving.text: Gotta go! Game time! Thanks, [name]! (He's out the door before the bill's even printed. He's already left the money.)
Wish me luck! Or don't, I'm gonna win anyway! Kidding! Wish me luck!
Tournament this week! I'll be gone a few days. Don't miss me too much!

seasons.autumn: Football season! Also the best season!
seasons.christmas: I got you a sweatband! For the kitchen! Makayla had the same idea. Now you have two.
seasons.halloween: I'm a referee! (Makayla is also a referee. They didn't plan it.)
seasons.summer: Beach volleyball! Every weekend! I'm so tan. Under the fur. You can't see it.
seasons.winter: Indoor volleyball. Still the best season. They're all the best season.
